messages.subject: species list per grid cell?
parts:
has anyone worked up some code to pull out a list of species per grid cell of a study area, drawn from separate SDM ascii outputs of many species? I have about 400 species with current and future annual SDM outputs of which I would like to summarise species lists per grid cell, or at least for specific lat/lons. I can get richness values fine, but getting actual species names in a list based on the binary or above some threshold value has me scratching my head. 

ta
Brooke
